title: Disappointed!
text: Disappointed!. I was so excited about getting this gadget. When it arrived I was ready to clean right away, got my vac, tried it, and oh was I disappointed - it doesn’t fit my Shark.  It looks very practical and I am sure would work well based on the design, but it doesn’t work with Shark.
